verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents three kinds of transaction reports, including itemized exports with a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction. The standalone Tax Transactions API also gives programmatic access to recorded transactions. This covers export of tax transaction data, but not a complete, open-format data takeout. Missing for 10: explicit export file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), a full-account export covering all data (registrations, settings, tax codes), and any documented migration or offboarding path or independent corroboration.
